biography.value:
A cheerful Felyne artisan cook who keeps Rank 1 camp meals ready for hunters.

Camp Kitchen Aura (10 ft): PCs in range get Ask for a Meal (Rank 1) on their sheet. GM: use Refresh Kitchen Aura once after placing the cook.

Request Meal (Rank 1): GM can also hand off cooking to a nearby hunter.

Menus loaded: Rank 1 only. Daily Skills are inactive templates used for automatic grants.
biography.public: A Felyne cook offering Rank 1 artisan meals at camp.

description.value:
Camp Kitchen Aura (10 ft)

Allied characters within 10 feet of the Felyne Cook gain Ask for a Meal (Rank 1) on their own sheet.

Leaving the aura removes that feature.

GM: after placing the cook (or if PCs are already nearby), use Refresh Kitchen Aura once so everyone currently in range receives the feature.

Requires Active Auras for the visual/temp effect. Feature granting also syncs by distance (token move).
description.chat: Kitchen aura: nearby hunters can Ask for a Meal (Rank 1).

description.chatFlavor: Refresh Ask for a Meal grants for hunters within 10 ft.

effects.name: Camp Kitchen Aura (10 ft)
effects.description: You are near the Felyne Cook and can use Ask for a Meal (Rank 1).

macro.name: Camp Kitchen Aura

description.value:
Request Meal (Rank 1) — GM handoff

  1. GM: choose a hunter token within 10 ft of the cook.
  2. Player: run the whispered handoff macro (or use Ask for a Meal (Rank 1) if they received it from the kitchen aura).
  3. Average three checks vs the meal DC. Success grants the meal feature; +4 / +8 → Daily Skills.

Requires MidiQOL + Item Macro. Nearby PCs also get Ask via Active Auras (10 ft).

Ask for a Meal (Rank 1)

While you are within 10 feet of the Felyne Cook, you can request a Rank 1 meal for yourself (1 serving).

Choose a meal, then assign ability scores to the three cooking steps chosen by the cook.

Granted automatically when you enter the Camp Kitchen Aura. Template copies on players are named "Ask for a Meal (Rank 1)".
